notes:
Inbound via docs-search blog post. Self-serve signup -> used free credits to call embeddings endpoint. Early discovery notes:
- Goal: add semantic doc search + live RAG answers to support KB and internal help center.
- Current infra: Postgres primary, experimenting with Pinecone (trial). Considering Weaviate for metadata filters. No infra lock required — prefer hosted.
- Workload: mixed read-heavy doc search + occasional multi-doc RAG generation. Expected QPS: 5-20; peak ~50 during campaigns. Latency target: 100-300ms for search path, okay if generation adds 300-600ms. Cost sensitive — looking to minimize token spend on generation + avoid expensive cross-embedding reruns.
- Models: leaning open-embedding models; asked about Redwood embedding compat and quantization impact. Wants recommendation for embedding model + reranker combo.
- Reranking: interested in hybrid approach (BM25 + embedding topK then rerank with 2-3-shot cross-encoder). Wants example config and token cost estimate.
- Vector DB questions: connector patterns, chunk id tracking, metadata filters for customer/tenant isolation, incremental upserts.
- Security: need SSO (SAML), audit logs, and basic retention controls. No strict residency requirement today.
- Quote from product lead: "We want something that just works with Pinecone — minimal glue code, predictable costs."
- Sales touch: AE did 30m intro call 2026-03-01; SE call scheduled 2026-03-22.
- POC plan: 2-week pilot indexing ~50k docs, test retrieval+rerank quality on 10 prompt suites, measure latency/cost.
- Current blockers: confirm Redwood SDK examples for Pinecone, provide quick rough cost estimates, and security questionnaire answers.
